maya: Quick heads-up — All-hands this Fri 10:30am PT (hybrid). Agenda: 1) Exec update (2m) 2) Cross-team integration demo (Platform + Product, 12m) 3) Policy flags & compliance changes (Legal, 8m) 4) Q&A + open mic (10m). Recording will be posted after. Please drop any questions below by Thu EOD. Calendar + meeting link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/ah-1777778888 :spiral_calendar:
kevin: Can we add a 1-slide summary on Dedicated/Private rollout timeline? customers keep pinging on dates.
maya: yes — include a single slide with dates & impact. kevin can you draft or point to a doc?
kevin: I can draft a timeline slide, will post a link by Thu morning.
simona: I'll consolidate Qs into themes. Quick ask: prefix posts with [Q] so I can group them fast.
devon: Demo env is green. Plan: quick architecture walkthrough, live demo of cross-region routing, then a short perf chart. Will call out fallback behavior.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: PROD rollout for infra-service v2.4.1 completed at 1777777700 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:
lisa: For the policy flags segment — are we changing any Console defaults or just adding guardrails? need to know for docs and SDK notices.
rachel-legal: We'll cover high-level intent (data residency + flagging), and tech team will own exact config change plan. No Console default flips in Fri call — just announcement + opt-in window.
maya: good — so call will be announcement first, tech follow-up doc pinned to the channel after.
kevin: also, can we surface customer-facing messaging? a short paragraph we can reuse in the portal/email.
maya: yes, we'll draft a canonical notice. assign to @kevin and @rachel-legal to co-author.
simona: collecting Qs so far: [Q] will the policy flag require migration? [Q] Dedicated timeline for EU region? [Q] Performance regression risk on quantized models?
maya: thanks — please keep them coming. reminder — keep questions concise so we can triage before the live Q&A.
devon: small ask for the demo: can we get a dedicated slot on the stage share? will need ~2 min to run logs/metrics dashboard.
maya: noted. ops-team — can you reserve stage for devon at t+5?
ops-bot: ops-bot: stage booked for 10:42am PT, presenter: devon.
lisa: I'll start a docs PR draft after the call, will tag @devon for the demo screenshots.
kevin: timeline slide link: https://docs.redwood.ai/slides/dedicated-rollout-draft — comments welcome.
maya: wrap-up before the call: please be on mute unless presenting, post any slides to the #all-hands-slides folder by Thu EOD. we'll keep the total meeting to ~35 mins.
--- (POST-CALL) ---
maya: Recording is up: https://redwood.internal/recordings/1777778888-allhands.mp4
Key takeaways:
- Exec: steady growth, hiring focus for infra & platform teams. (Maya)
- Demo: cross-company integration works; fallback routing kept latency within SLOs in our tests. (Devon)
- Policy flags: announcement only, opt-in window of 30 days, no Console defaults flipped today. (Rachel)
- Docs + customer messaging: draft by next Tue, release aligned with opt-in window. (Lisa/kevin)
Action items:
- AI-1: kevin + rachel-legal -> publish customer-facing notice draft (due: Tue EOD) [owner: kevin]
- AI-2: devon -> upload demo artifacts & perf charts to the repo (due: Mon) [owner: devon]
- AI-3: docs -> PR with console update instructions (due: Wed) [owner: lisa]
- AI-4: eng-platform -> run a canary for policy-flag routing (start: next week) [owner: ops-team]
Thanks everyone for keeping to time. If you had a question that didn't make the Q&A, drop it here or DM @simona and we'll follow up. :raised_hands:
maya: I'll post a short internal summary and follow-up threads for each action item later today.
